item.title: Event-based frost and heat damage functions improve yield predictions of APSIM canola and wheat: formulation, calibration, and evaluation
Optimising Canola Phenology
item.description: This project combines multiple research areas including crop modelling and genomics, and molecular markers and aims to improve accuracy in predicting phenogy for current and newly released canola cultivars across the Australian grain belt to improve the model performance and estimate new parameters using crop model and genetic information.
